title: Q2 Results Live Updates: Wipro, Tech Mahindra set to announce September quarter earnings today. Check brokerage estimates, share price - The Economic Times
text: Q2 Results Today Live: Wipro is expected to report modest earnings growth for the September quarter, with investor focus likely to shift to its December-quarter outlook, deal ramp-ups and the impact of artificial intelligence on revenue. The IT services major is estimated to post around 9% year-on-year (YoY) revenue growth and 2% profit growth, based on the average estimates of seven brokerages.
